_comment: CANDIDATE car build for switching to AUX when its signal appears, on top of the aux-boot-restore build. NOT tested on hardware; aux-signal-switch is verified only under emulation (handler and dispatch window). Flash it only after the aux-boot-restore car test has been read. LOCAL build manifest: edit the paths below before reusing.

_pairs.aux-always-available: AUX selectable and available (the first half of aux-autoswitch)
_pairs.aux-sticky: the second half of aux-autoswitch, plus: losing the signal no longer releases AUX, so a paused phone does not fall back to FM
_pairs.aux-boot-restore: AUX's requests sent without PrOnly, and the restored priority forced to 20
_pairs.aux-signal-switch: the AUX handler reads the signal instead of the setting, and the media dispatch sends the signal event (0xcc) to it

_settings: No USER_DATA payload, so the car's own settings - paired phones, destinations, presets - are NOT touched.
